GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn going well. kicked clear in Straight . tired late # just did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer was questioned regarding the mare racing further forward today and in respect to its apparent improved performance. Trainer advised that whilst the mare had been getting back in its two previous race starts, the intention had been to be forward. He added that following its last start, he had removed the mare’s cross-over nose band and its ear-muffs and he attributed that to be the reason for the mare being able to lead, both in its lead in prev barrier trial and today, and for its winning performance today.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 2 Lengths sat clear last 12+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # Tardy/never in it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the mare reared as the start was effected and lost ground, and in her opinion, it resented the crossover noseband and winkers and, as a result, failed to quicken once placed under pressure through the early stages before becoming tailed off.
